comment: The inventory asks whether each system aligns with a REDDHI component. This may bias the assessment toward the reference component catalogue rather than first identifying national capabilities, workflows, and needs.

anchor.note: p.89 l.Lines 34-38 read as the printed page; section 4.1.2 agrees

public.text: The inventory asks whether each system aligns with a REDDHI component. This may bias the assessment toward the reference component catalogue rather than first identifying national capabilities, workflows, and needs.
public.suggestedRevision: Begin with a capability and service inventory, then map existing systems to DPI-H reference components. Allow one system to realise several components and one component to be distributed across several systems.
